description: Optional declarative local-first workflow scheduler pack for recurring tasks, monitors, wakeups, follow-ups, cron-like schedules, delivery handoffs, retry policy, evidence, and stop conditions.

notes: This pack defines schedule contracts and does not install or execute automations.
Defaultspack and app automation tools keep approval, audit, and execution ownership.
Connector, agent service, and release packs keep their own routing and policy authority.

base_pack_promotion.reason: Scheduling contracts should remain optional and must not become implicit automation, delivery, or approval authority.

conflict_notes: This pack complements defaultspack scheduler and app automation surfaces; it does not replace them.
This pack complements rumi_agent_services_pack, rumi_connector_gateway_pack, and rumi_devops_release_pack by defining schedule contracts only.
Owner packs and runtime policy remain the enforcement boundary.
security_notes: No secrets, executable scheduler code, network connector code, message delivery code, or remote endpoints are embedded.
Network is none by default and all schedule records are local metadata until an owner surface accepts them.
